newsitem.title: USA: FED ADDS RESERVES VIA 4-DAY FIXED SYSTEM RPS.
newsitem.headline: FED ADDS RESERVES VIA 4-DAY FIXED SYSTEM RPS.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves into the banking system through a round of four-day fixed system repurchase agreements on Thursday, the New York Fed confirmed.
The operation was expected, as the Fed is seen facing a $6.0 billion average daily add need in the second half of the two-week maintenance period beginning this session.
Federal funds were trading at the 5-1/2 percent target at the time of the operation.
